blocks.text: 2 Chronicles 1 contains 17 verses. It opens with: And Solomon the son of David was strengthened in his kingdom, and Jehovah his God was with him, and magnified him exceedingly. It concludes with: And they fetched up and brought out of Egypt a chariot for six hundred `shekels' of silver, and a horse for a hundred and fifty: and so for all the kings of the Hittites, and the kings of Syria, did they bring them out by their means.
